children: On September 25, 2026, the company received two Nasdaq deficiency notices for failing to meet the $1.00 minimum bid price under Rule 5550(a)(2) and the $35 million Market Value of Listed Securities under Rule 5550(b)(2). The notices have no immediate effect; Dyadic has until March 24, 2027 to regain compliance by meeting each threshold for at least 10 consecutive business days, with potential for an additional 180-day bid price compliance period if criteria are met.
